samples.scenario: Google Cloud Storage bucket configured with public read access exposing internal project documentation containing API keys and internal network diagrams.

technical_data.gsutil_ls_command:
$ gsutil ls -L gs://internal-project-docs
Bucket: gs://internal-project-docs/
Location: US
Storage class: STANDARD
ACL:
  allUsers: READER
technical_data.http_get_request:
GET /internal-project-docs/network_diagram.pdf HTTP/1.1
Host: storage.googleapis.com
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0
Accept: */*
technical_data.http_get_response_headers:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/pdf
Content-Length: 234567
Date: Mon, 05 Jun 2023 12:34:56 GMT
Server: UploadServer
technical_data.sample_data_excerpt:
%PDF-1.4
% Project internal network design
% API_KEY=AIzaSyD***************
<<network diagram content>>
technical_data.cspm_alert_sample:
{
  "resource_id": "projects/_/buckets/internal-project-docs",
  "issue_type": "Publicly accessible bucket",
  "severity": "High",
  "details": "Bucket ACL grants READ access to allUsers, exposing sensitive internal documents.",
  "recommendation": "Remove allUsers from bucket ACL and restrict access to authorized users only."
}

indicators: Bucket ACL includes 'allUsers' with READER role
Audit logs show anonymous principal accessing storage.objects.get method
HTTP 200 responses serving sensitive PDF files containing API keys
Presence of internal project documentation and network diagrams publicly accessible
CSPM alerts flagging public access to sensitive GCS bucket
samples.detection_method: Automated scanning of Google Cloud Storage bucket ACLs and IAM policies to detect presence of 'allUsers' or 'allAuthenticatedUsers' with read permissions, monitoring Cloud Audit Logs for unauthenticated object access events, correlating IP addresses and user agents to identify anomalous accesses, and inspecting HTTP server logs for public downloads of sensitive files.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
T1552.001 - Credentials in Files: Cloud Storage Object

samples.scenario: Azure Blob Storage container configured with 'Container (anonymous read access for containers and blobs)' public access level exposing backup files containing database credentials and user information.

GET /backup-container/db_backup_2023_05_10.bak HTTP/1.1
Host: companystorage.blob.core.windows.net
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0
Accept: */*

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/octet-stream
Content-Length: 52428800
Last-Modified: Wed, 10 May 2023 08:00:00 GMT
x-ms-request-id: 12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab
x-ms-version: 2021-04-10
Server: Windows-Azure-Blob/1.0 Microsoft-HTTPAPI/2.0
technical_data.sample_data_excerpt: Backup file contains SQL Server database dump with plaintext credentials: username=admin; password=SuperSecret123!
technical_data.cspm_alert_sample:
{
  "resource_id": "/subscriptions/xxxx/resourceGroups/rg1/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/companystorage/blobServices/default/containers/backup-container",
  "issue_type": "Public container access",
  "severity": "High",
  "details": "Container 'backup-container' is configured for anonymous read access, exposing sensitive backup files.",
  "recommendation": "Change container public access level to Private and implement RBAC controls."
}

indicators: Azure Blob Storage container publicAccess property set to 'container' allowing anonymous read access
Azure Activity logs showing anonymous caller performing blob read operations
HTTP 200 responses serving large binary backup files containing database credentials
Presence of sensitive backup files publicly accessible without authentication
CSPM alerts detecting publicly accessible blob containers with sensitive data
samples.detection_method: Regular audits of Azure Blob Storage containers' public access settings using Azure Security Center or third-party CSPM tools, monitoring Azure Activity Logs for anonymous access to blob read operations, alerting when container publicAccess is set to 'container' or 'blob', and analyzing network logs or HTTP access logs for suspicious large file downloads from storage endpoints.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
T1552.001 - Credentials in Files: Cloud Storage Object
